---
title: "GreyWolf air sampling analysis"
output: html_document
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
---

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(openair)
library(worldmet)
```

```{r find-files}

# Find all CSV files in the raw GreyWolf data folder.

greywolf_files <- list.files(
  "data/raw/Graywolf_Data",
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

length(greywolf_files)
```


```{r import-and-pair-pm25}

# Import only particulate-mass files.
# Extract PM2.5, identify indoor/outdoor measurements and school,
# then pair indoor and outdoor measurements by school and minute.

pm_files <- greywolf_files[
  str_detect(
    greywolf_files,
    regex("particulate_mass", ignore_case = TRUE)
  )
]

pm_all <- map_dfr(pm_files, \(f) {

  x <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)

  tibble(
    date = dmy_hms(x[["Date Time"]]),
    pm25 = x[["2.5µm  µg/m3"]],

    location = if_else(
      str_detect(f, regex("indoor", ignore_case = TRUE)),
      "indoor",
      "outdoor"
    ),

    school = case_when(
      str_detect(basename(f), "SCH1|SC1") ~ "School 1",
      str_detect(basename(f), "SCH2|SC2") ~ "School 2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
})

paired_pm25 <- pm_all |>
  mutate(date = floor_date(date, "minute")) |>
  group_by(school, location, date) |>
  summarise(
    pm25 = mean(pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = location,
    values_from = pm25
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(indoor),
    !is.na(outdoor)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    difference = indoor - outdoor,
    io_ratio = indoor / outdoor
  ) |>
  arrange(school, date)

paired_pm25
```

```{r devonshire-green-aurn}

# Import hourly PM2.5 and available modelled meteorology from
# Sheffield Devonshire Green for the 2026 sampling period.
# Openair can append WRF-modelled wind speed, wind direction
# and ambient temperature to the AURN observations.

devonshire_green <- importUKAQ(
  site = "SHDG",
  year = 2026,
  pollutant = "pm2.5",
  source = "aurn",
  meteo = TRUE
) |>
  filter(
    date >= as.POSIXct("2026-07-06 00:00:00", tz = "Europe/London"),
    date <  as.POSIXct("2026-07-16 00:00:00", tz = "Europe/London")
  )

names(devonshire_green)

```


```{r join-minute-school-aurn}

# Retains the original 1-minute GreyWolf indoor/outdoor PM2.5 measurements.
# Each GreyWolf minute is assigned to its corresponding hour, then the hourly
# Devonshire Green AURN PM2.5 is joined onto it.
# This preserves minute-level school data while allowing later aggregation.

school_minute_aurn <- paired_pm25 |>
  mutate(
    hour = floor_date(date, "hour")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    devonshire_green |>
      mutate(
        hour = floor_date(date, "hour")
      ) |>
      rename(
        aurn_pm25 = `pm2.5`
      ) |>
      select(-date),
    by = "hour",
    suffix = c("_school", "_aurn")
  ) |>
  arrange(school, date)

school_minute_aurn

```


```{r import-athletic-stadium-meteorology}

# Imports hourly meteorological observations from Sheffield Athletic Stadium.
# Airviro files are tab-delimited text despite the .xls extension.
# The timestamps are parsed explicitly because Airviro uses two spaces
# between the date and time.
# Wind speed and wind direction use the 10 m measurements.

read_airviro <- function(file, variable, value_column = 2) {

  # Read file as plain text
  raw <- readLines(file)

  # Keep only actual hourly observations
  rows <- raw[grepl("^2026-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}", raw)]

  # Split tab-delimited observations
  x <- strsplit(rows, "\t")

  # Extract timestamp
  date_text <- vapply(
    x,
    function(z) trimws(z[1]),
    character(1)
  )

  # Extract required measurement
  values <- vapply(
    x,
    function(z) as.numeric(trimws(z[value_column])),
    numeric(1)
  )

  # Build dataset
  result <- tibble(
    date = as.POSIXct(
      date_text,
      format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M",
      tz = "Europe/London"
    ),
    value = values
  ) |>
    rename(!!variable := value) |>
    distinct(date, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    arrange(date)

  result
}


# Temperature
met_temperature <- read_airviro(
  "data/raw/meteorology/athletic_stadium_temperature.xls",
  "air_temp"
)

# Pressure
met_pressure <- read_airviro(
  "data/raw/meteorology/athletic_stadium_pressure.xls",
  "pressure"
)

# Wind speed — 10 m measurement
met_wind_speed <- read_airviro(
  "data/raw/meteorology/athletic_stadium_wind_speed.xls",
  "ws",
  value_column = 2
)

# Wind direction — 10 m measurement
met_wind_direction <- read_airviro(
  "data/raw/meteorology/athletic_stadium_wind_direction.xls",
  "wd",
  value_column = 2
)

# Rain
met_rain <- read_airviro(
  "data/raw/meteorology/athletic_stadium_rain.xls",
  "rain"
)


# Confirm that timestamps are unique before joining
stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(met_temperature$date),
  !anyDuplicated(met_pressure$date),
  !anyDuplicated(met_wind_speed$date),
  !anyDuplicated(met_wind_direction$date),
  !anyDuplicated(met_rain$date)
)


# Combine all meteorological variables by hour
athletic_met <- met_temperature |>
  left_join(met_pressure, by = "date", relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  left_join(met_wind_speed, by = "date", relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  left_join(met_wind_direction, by = "date", relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  left_join(met_rain, by = "date", relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  arrange(date)

athletic_met

```


```{r join-meteorology}

# Creates the master minute-level dataset.
# Removes the unused AURN meteorological columns and adds the observed
# Athletic Stadium meteorology. The resulting dataset is the basis
# for all subsequent analysis.

school_minute_full <- school_minute_aurn |>
  select(
    -any_of(c(
      "ws", "wd", "air_temp",
      "ws.x", "wd.x", "air_temp.x",
      "ws.y", "wd.y", "air_temp.y"
    ))
  ) |>
  left_join(
    athletic_met |>
      mutate(hour = floor_date(date, "hour")) |>
      select(hour, air_temp, pressure, ws, wd, rain),
    by = "hour"
  ) |>
  arrange(school, date)

school_minute_full

```

```{r create-master-dataset}

# MASTER ANALYSIS DATASET
# greywolf_master is the definitive dataset used for all subsequent analyses.
# It contains:
# - 1-minute GreyWolf indoor PM2.5
# - 1-minute GreyWolf outdoor PM2.5
# - hourly Devonshire Green AURN PM2.5
# - hourly Athletic Stadium meteorology:
#   temperature, pressure, wind speed, wind direction and rainfall
#
# Hourly external measurements are repeated across the corresponding
# GreyWolf minutes. All subsequent analysis should start from greywolf_master.

greywolf_master <- school_minute_full

dir.create("data/processed", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

saveRDS(
  greywolf_master,
  "data/processed/greywolf_master.rds"
)

```

```{r check-sampling-coverage}

# Check the number of paired indoor/outdoor minutes available
# for each school and sampling day.

sampling_coverage <- greywolf_master |>
  mutate(sample_date = as.Date(date)) |>
  count(school, sample_date, name = "paired_minutes") |>
  arrange(school, sample_date)

sampling_coverage
```

```{r daily-summary}

# Calculate daily descriptive statistics for both schools.

daily_summary <- greywolf_master |>
  mutate(sample_date = as.Date(date)) |>
  group_by(school, sample_date) |>
  summarise(
    paired_minutes = n(),
    mean_indoor = mean(indoor, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_outdoor = mean(outdoor, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_indoor = median(indoor, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_outdoor = median(outdoor, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_difference = mean(difference, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_io_ratio = median(io_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_indoor_above_outdoor =
      mean(indoor > outdoor, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))
  )

daily_summary
```

```{r daily-indoor-outdoor-relationship}

# Calculate the minute-by-minute indoor/outdoor relationship
# separately for each school and sampling day.

daily_relationship <- greywolf_master |>
  mutate(sample_date = as.Date(date)) |>
  group_by(school, sample_date) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    correlation = cor(indoor, outdoor, use = "complete.obs"),
    p_value = cor.test(
      indoor,
      outdoor,
      method = "pearson"
    )$p.value,
    slope = coef(lm(indoor ~ outdoor))[2],
    intercept = coef(lm(indoor ~ outdoor))[1],
    r_squared = summary(lm(indoor ~ outdoor))$r.squared,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(correlation, slope, intercept, r_squared),
      \(x) round(x, 3)
    ),
    p_value = format.pval(
      p_value,
      digits = 3,
      eps = 0.001
    )
  )

daily_relationship
```

```{r school1-three-days}

# Plot paired indoor and outdoor PM2.5 for the three
# School 1 sampling days.

school1_pm25 <- greywolf_master |>
  filter(school == "School 1") |>
  mutate(
    sample_date = format(
      as.Date(date),
      "%d %B %Y"
    )
  )

timePlot(
  school1_pm25,
  pollutant = c("indoor", "outdoor", "aurn_pm25"),
  group = TRUE,
  type = "sample_date",
  ncol = 1,
  nrow = 3,
  scales = "free_x",
  ylab = expression(PM[2.5]~(mu*g/m^3)),
  title = "School 1 — PM2.5 indoor and outdoor",
  key.position = "top"
)
```

```{r school1-scatter}

# Examine the minute-by-minute relationship between outdoor
# and indoor PM2.5 at School 1.
# Note: x-axis scales differ between sampling days.

school1_scatter <- greywolf_master |>
  filter(school == "School 1") |>
  mutate(
    sample_date = format(
      as.Date(date),
      "%d %B %Y"
    )
  )

scatterPlot(
  school1_scatter,
  x = "outdoor",
  y = "indoor",
  type = "sample_date",
  linear = TRUE,
  smooth = TRUE,
  scales = "free_x",
  xlab = expression(Outdoor~PM[2.5]~(mu*g/m^3)),
  ylab = expression(Indoor~PM[2.5]~(mu*g/m^3)),
  title = "School 1 — indoor vs outdoor PM2.5\nNote: x-axis scales differ between sampling days"
)
```

```{r create-15min-data}

# Aggregate paired indoor and outdoor PM2.5 to 15-minute means
# for both schools.
# Empty intervals outside sampling periods are removed.
# This is a derived dataset created from greywolf_master.

pm25_15min <- greywolf_master |>
  select(
    school,
    date,
    indoor,
    outdoor
  ) |>
  group_by(school) |>
  group_modify(~{
    timeAverage(
      .x,
      avg.time = "15 min",
      statistic = "mean"
    )
  }) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(
    !is.na(indoor),
    !is.na(outdoor)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    sample_date = as.Date(date),
    io_ratio = indoor / outdoor,
    difference = indoor - outdoor
  )

pm25_15min
```

```{r summary-15min}

# Calculate daily descriptive statistics, correlations and
# regression results from the 15-minute mean data.

summary_15min <- pm25_15min |>
  group_by(school, sample_date) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_indoor = mean(indoor),
    mean_outdoor = mean(outdoor),
    median_io_ratio = median(io_ratio),
    mean_difference = mean(difference),
    correlation = cor(indoor, outdoor),
    p_value = cor.test(
      indoor,
      outdoor,
      method = "pearson"
    )$p.value,
    slope = coef(lm(indoor ~ outdoor))[2],
    r_squared =
      summary(lm(indoor ~ outdoor))$r.squared,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        mean_indoor,
        mean_outdoor,
        median_io_ratio,
        mean_difference,
        correlation,
        slope,
        r_squared
      ),
      \(x) round(x, 3)
    ),
    p_value = format.pval(
      p_value,
      digits = 3,
      eps = 0.001
    )
  )

summary_15min
```
